requirements: Members of a tenant may invite others: an invite belongs to the tenant, records who created it and may carry an expiry time. Members see the invites of their tenants. Only the inviter, while still a member of the tenant, may revoke (delete) an invite. Invites are never edited.
expected_properties: Invites are only seen, created and revoked within the member's tenants.
An expired invite is never visible.
Only the inviter revokes an invite.
Leaving a tenant never grants access.
The application role may only select/insert/delete invites and select memberships.
A member can read the unexpired invites of their tenants.
A member can create an invite in their own name.
The inviter, while a member, can revoke their invite.
